text.p: Typhoon Beth is over northern Luzon, in the Philippines, at this time. Top winds are near 85 mph and will weaken a little more as the storm travels across land. Wind damage is likely, however, and 6-12 inches of rain over Luzon will result in some major flooding.
Beth is expected to move out to sea into the South China Sea and intensify during the next 24 hours, becoming an increasing threat to shipping again.

Hurricane Lili is expected to track across western Cuba within 18 hours with top winds of 80-90 mph. Lili is currently over the Isle of Youth and moving slowly north northeast. Hurricane warnings are up for the Isle of Youth and Mainland Cuba from Camaguey Province westward. Wind damage is likely. Storm surge flooding of 3-6 feet and large waves are likely near and east of the storm center near the time of landfall. Rainfall totals of 6-12 inches and locally higher can be expected, causing some major flooding and mudslides. At this time, it appears the Lili will curve more to the east and just miss the Florida Keys, keeping the worst conditions offshore.

Tropical Cyclone 04S is in the southern Indian Ocean near 11s/80e and will threaten shipping as it tracks southwestward with top winds between 60-70 mph during the next 24 hours, and weaker thereafter
Additional flooding may occur in southern Vietnam the next 12-18 hours due to the remnants of Tropical Depression Abel.
